summary.en: Rock's root grammar: twelve bars, bent notes, storytelling voice.
summary.zh: 摇滚的根语法：十二小节、弯音、诉说式演唱。

body.en: Blues is not a side branch of rock—it is the source grammar. From Delta acoustic to Chicago electric blues, rhythm and bent-note phrasing shape early Rock 'n' Roll and keep showing up in Hard Rock and Metal solos.
body.zh: Blues 不是摇滚的旁支，而是源语法。从三角洲原声到芝加哥电蓝调，节奏与弯音乐句塑造早期 Rock 'n' Roll，并在 Hard Rock 与 Metal 的 Solo 中反复出现。
